verdict.rationale: Linear ships an in-app AI assistant, Linear Agent, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows it learning a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences to tailor its output. Shared skills and 'Write with Agent' drafting are related workflow features, not personalization or preference learning, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
